static_traits.name: 陈婕
static_traits.social_status: 与同行关系因自信not足而受影响；有音乐圈朋友但难以敞开心扉寻求支持
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without以往心理咨询或精神科治疗史；without类似问题既往史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、条理性好，能自我Reflection；配合度高，略显紧张但整体积极

basic_info.main_problem: 因同时学习与教授多种乐器而感到overwhelmed与自卑，认为手小会让我永远without法精通任何一种乐器，这种not足感在授课与演出中经常出现并加重，影响教学效果、睡眠与专注，并使与同行的Relationship tension。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望通过咨询改变not合理的消极思维、检验“手小=without法精通”的信念，重拾对音乐与教学的热情与自信。
growth_experiences: 在开始学习多种乐器并与他人比较后，逐渐形成“我not如人、手小是永久障碍”的not足感与Self-doubt；随着难度与对比增加，难以看到自身进步，挫败感与Worsened self-negation，演出与授课时反复出现负面评价。
去年参加一次小提琴独奏音乐会，充分准备后发挥出色，获得观众大量赞赏，当天感到自信与被认可；这一经历提示充分练习与正向反馈能显著提升Self-efficacy。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not如人
My physical limitations determine my ability and worth

special_situations.event: 在钢琴授课时够not到某些音，面前有Student旁听/学习
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在Student面前出现技术失误，就说明我是not称职的老师
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习、向同事寻求安慰与肯定以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我教得not行，我永远也without法精通

special_situations.event: After class, watching videos of performers with bigger hands and comparing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人做得更轻松、条件更好，我就永远not可能达到他们的水平
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces in-depth exchanges with peers to avoid being compared or evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我注定达not到他们的水平

special_situations.event: Before and after performances and teaching, repeatedly thinks 'small hands are a permanent obstacle'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 身体的先天限制会决定我without法精通任何一种乐器
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 事先向他人寻求保证、过度练习以对冲not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的小手会一直拖累我，not yet来也会失败

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback or recalling successful performances (e.g., last year's praised violin solo)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成功not能持续，就not算真正的能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视或淡化积极证据，专注not足以“督促自己”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那只是运气，not代表我真的行

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与赞赏，成为胜任且被尊重的Musician和Teacher
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因身体限制而被negate、被羞辱，without法胜任Teacher与演奏者角色
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与negate来预防外界批评带来的羞耻
通过寻求他人保证与过度练习来暂时缓解Anxiety
Reduces in-depth contact with peers to avoid being compared and judged

object_relations.self_representation: A restricted, error-prone teacher/performer who needs to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、评判性的Student/同行/观众
Supportive, appreciative audiences/peers who give positive feedback

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's successful experiences or invites recalling positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些成功是偶然且not可持续，担心咨询师过于乐观、not了解自己的“限制”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平缓但带有Self-denial，use“只是碰巧”“not算数”等词语轻描淡写地淡化成功。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师建议与同行或朋友寻求支持、开放表达Self-doubt时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worried that exposing vulnerability will be judged or looked down on, attributing inner self-criticism to others' thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 婉转回避，强调“他们很忙”“说了也not用”，并尝试转换话题或聚焦技术性细节。

manifestations: 与同行关系因自信not足而紧张，难以向朋友敞开谈Self-doubt
not足感影响对音乐与教学的热情
正向体验被迅速negate，难以从成就中获得持续意义感

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中频繁Self-denial，强调“I am not good enough”“永远without法精通”
Worries excessively about others' evaluations before making decisions and shrinks self-expression

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 本可向朋友求助却选择更努力地独自练习以对冲Anxiety
Turns the energy of expecting others' support into self-pressure and excessive practice

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: When talking about peers, assumes 'they are better and will look down on me', thus reducing communication
Attributes inner self-criticism experiences to others' judgments

exception_events.target_problem: 在演出情境下，陈婕通常会因Self-doubt与“手小”信念而感到not足，担心发挥失常，难以稳定呈现。
exception_events.unique_outcome: In a violin solo last year, Chen Jie prepared fully, performed excellently on site, and received much praise, experiencing strong confidence and a sense of control.
exception_events.reason: Clue: adopted fuller practice and preparation; obtained on-site positive feedback; task focus clear, reducing comparison.

exception_events.target_problem: 在授课时，陈婕通常会因技术细节受阻与Self-doubt而产生尴尬与自责，进而怀疑教学能力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 曾有一次课程，她准备充分、结构清晰，课堂反馈Good，Self-efficacy提升，课后not yet陷入长期Self-denial。
exception_events.reason: Clue: concrete teaching goals were set, rehearsal was done before class, and concretized feedback from colleagues was obtained promptly.

positive_force: Has solid training and practical foundations; can improve performance through preparation
Open to growth, willing to try recording practice and seeking concrete feedback
Has music-circle friends and potential mentor resources
有过成功演出与Good授课的经验，可作为自我效能证据
negative_force: 持久的Self-doubt与外部比较倾向
灾难化、过度概括与negate积极等认知偏差
寻求外部保证与回避暴露脆弱，导致The support system has difficulty functioning

target_behavior.behavior: 消极自我言语与灾难化思维（如“我永远without法精通任何乐器”）
antecedent: Technical difficulties during teaching or performances
After watching videos of others playing more easily, makes comparisons
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在核心信念“I am not good enough”“身体限制决定能力”，并通过比较与选择性注意放大证据
target_behavior.function: 短期缓解not确定性、为可能的失败做心理防御；寻求控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 自卑与Anxiety worsened，教学与演出表现下降，睡眠与Impaired concentration

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive comparison and repeatedly browsing others' performance videos
antecedent: After setbacks in class or practice
准备演出或授课前的Anxiety时段
target_behavior.core_reason: Seeks external reference points to validate negative beliefs and gain external recognition
target_behavior.function: 逃避面对自身客观进步评估，短时降低not安
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪恶化、Decreased drive，与同行互动减少、Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeks reassurance from others (seeking affirmation or comfort from colleagues or friends)
antecedent: When facing new challenges or high-standard tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: 内在自我评估not稳定，过度依赖外部肯定以维持自尊
target_behavior.consequence: Forms a dependence on external affirmation, hard to build stable inner self-efficacy
